(rule!
  (let* ((div-row (find-first (lambda (r) (for/and ([c (range 0 w)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 h)))
         (div-col (find-first (lambda (c) (for/and ([r (range 0 h)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 w))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (find-color g 7)])
      (let* ((r (first p)) (c (second p))
             (nr (if div-col r (- (* 2 div-row) r)))
             (nc (if div-col (- (* 2 div-col) c) c)))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (set-cell out nr nc 7) out)))))

    (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (find-color g 7)])
      (let* ((r (first p)) (c (second p))
             (nr (if div-col r (- (* 2 div-row) r)))

(rule!
  (let* ([closed ((lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (let* ((div-row (find-first (lambda (r) (for/and ([c (range 0 w)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 h)))
         (div-col (find-first (lambda (c) (for/and ([r (range 0 h)]) (= (at g r c) 8))) (range 0 w))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (find-color g 7)])
      (let* ((r (first p)) (c (second p))
             (nr (if div-col r (- (* 2 div-row) r)))
             (nc (if div-col (- (* 2 div-col) c) c)))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (set-cell out nr nc 7) out)))))) g)]
         [parts (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 7)) (objects closed 0))]
         [largest (if (empty? parts) 0 (apply max (map obj-size parts)))])
    (for/fold ([out closed]) ([o parts] #:when (= (obj-size o) largest))
      (for/fold ([painted out]) ([p (obj-cells o)])
        (set-cell painted (first p) (second p) 2)))))
